contexts.text: That he should go into the streets and quarters () = that he should seek wherever there is any genuine truth, or truth which shines from good...
In the cities (there) streets and quarters appear.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] That a quarter, etc. = the truths which lead to good. References.
To run through the streets and seek in the quarters of Jerusalem () = to see and explore in the doctrinal things of that Church...
The streets and quarters = the truths of doctrine.
The streets of Jerusalem and its quarters = the truths of doctrine according to the states of affection and perception of those who are of the Church.

The quarters, in special, = the corners of the city, thus the quarters where they dwell; and as everyone lives in the cities (there) according to the clear or obscure-affection of good and perception of truth, the quarters = truths and goods according to the affection and perception of each one.

Desolation is described by, the ways have ceased... the quarters have ceased in Israel (). Ways, and paths, have a like signification to streets, and quarters, namely, the truths of doctrine which lead.
In all the streets mourning, and in all the quarters they say Alas! alas! () = grief on account of truth and good being devastated everywhere.
No cry in our quarters () = no lamentation anywhere over the lack of them.
Streets and quarters () = the truths of doctrine and the truths of life which lead to intelligence and wisdom.
As the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets ().
